node.statement: Scope closure for the conditional: fix arbitrary n >= 1, an extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, and bounded T in B(A), exactly as quantified in amended node 1.3, and define iota_n(T)([X_ij])=[T(X_ij)]. This gives iota_n(T) the declared domain and codomain M_n tensor A; node 1.3.2.1 proves that this entrywise operator is bounded, so iota_n(T) belongs to B(M_n tensor A) and sigma(iota_n(T)) and its holomorphic functional calculus are well-defined. Under the additional common-domain holomorphic-functional-calculus premise explicitly imposed by amended node 1.3, nodes 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 prove theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). Thus no unbound T, n, or iota_n remains; sibling 1.2 is unnecessary for scope because amended 1.3 itself quantifies and defines them.
